description.en:
The certificate ID.

> To obtain the certificate ID, call the [ListUserCertificateOrder](~~455804~~) operation.

descriptions.zh: 本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用将会被限流，这可能影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en: This operation is limited to 100 queries per second (QPS) per user. API calls exceeding this limit are throttled, which can impact your business. We recommend calling this operation at a reasonable rate to avoid this.
